adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when sync is enabled it calls `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: ... })` without any `AbortSignal`/timeout and returns the `Response` without checking `response.ok` or otherwise handling non-2xx. This is a concrete reliability/edge-case gap introduced by the diff (a slow/hung sync endpoint can block token refresh paths, and error responses aren’t explicitly validated here), but it’s more about robustness/error-handling policy than a strictly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
